title: Temporal Dependency Graph (TDG) v1
description: A document's dated facts and the typed temporal constraints between them. The interchange format between extractors, the entailment engine, the cross-document linker, and the chronology builder. Producers may emit extra fields; consumers must ignore fields they do not understand.

schema_version.description: Major.minor. Consumers reject unknown majors, tolerate unknown minors.

source_text.description: Full source text. Optional: bundles with sensitive content may ship offsets plus a source_text_sha256 instead.

source_text_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the source text, for provenance when source_text itself is externalised.

value.description: Normalised ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), partial date (YYYY-MM / YYYY), or ISO-8601 duration (P30D).

raw_text.description: Surface form of the temporal expression.

sentence.description: Source sentence — the quote carried into chronologies and derivations.

date_parsed.description: Fully resolved calendar date, when value resolves to one.

start_char.description: Offset of the timex in source_text. Provenance: viewers jump here.

is_duplicate_of.description: Within-document coreference. Flag-don't-drop: duplicates stay in the file, excluded from graph construction.

temporal_content.description: False = extractor mis-tagged a non-temporal clause. Kept for auditability; consumers may skip, must not delete.
